title: Which player will score Canada’s first FIFA World Cup goal on home soil by June 2026?
lesson: Do not overconcentrate on the all-time leading scorer when a national team regularly uses two established strikers. Preserve meaningful probability for the starting partner and other role-supported finishers.

title: Who will electronically sign the U.S.-Iran framework agreement as Tehran’s top negotiator by June 17, 2026?
lesson: Direct reporting that labels a named official with the exact role specified in the resolution criteria can justify very high confidence.

title: Who will score the United States’ first FIFA World Cup double since 1930 by June 19, 2026?
lesson: For brace-specific markets, give the starting center-forward's multi-goal upside at least as much weight as a more famous winger's general scoring reputation.

title: Who will score the United States’ final goal against Paraguay at the 2026 FIFA World Cup by June 13, 2026?
lesson: Final-goal markets require explicit probability for attacking midfielders and likely late substitutes, not just primary starters and center-forwards.
